description: FairValid verifies email addresses and offers FairMatch lead search for sales and marketing workflows. It provides hosted tools for AI agents as well as a separate customer API on the main fairvalid.com domain.
summary: FairValid exposes one OAuth-protected MCP server at https://mcp.fairvalid.com/mcp over Streamable HTTP; it supports either self-onboarding OAuth or a FairValid API key in the Authorization header.
